theme_central: The Qur'an made easy for remembrance — a refrain repeated after every account of destruction (Nuh, 'Ad, Thamud, Lot, Pharaoh), as if to ask: who then will remember?
sources_note: Five peoples confirmed (grokipedia, Wikipedia Al-Qamar) and refrain repeated at verses 17, 22, 32, 40 precisely sourced.

branches.title: The moon split asunder
branches.resume: The Hour draws near, the moon has split — a sign rejected by the disbelievers as "continuous magic".

children.t: The moon split asunder, sign rejected, mockery of the disbelievers

branches.title: Nuh, the flood
branches.resume: Rejection of Nuh by his people, the flood, rescue in the ark.

children.t: Nuh rejected, the flood, "the Qur'an made easy for remembrance"

branches.title: 'Ad
branches.resume: Destruction of the people of 'Ad by a howling, freezing wind.

branches.title: Thamud, the she-camel
branches.resume: Rejection of Salih and the sign of the she-camel, destruction by a single Cry.

children.t: Thamud, the she-camel, destruction by a single Cry

branches.title: Lot, Pharaoh
branches.resume: Lot's people destroyed by a rain of stones; Pharaoh and his people punished.

children.t: Lot's people destroyed by a rain of stones, except his believing family
Pharaoh and his people punished for rejecting the signs

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: The criminals in delusion, everything recorded in a Book; the pious in gardens with an Omnipotent Sovereign.

children.t: Everything recorded in a Book; the pious in Paradise with the Omnipotent Sovereign
